jobs.description: Overview Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. Additionally, there may be occasions where you will be required to travel outside your assigned area to assist in other territories. Successful candidates are able and willing to work flexible schedules and may be asked to work overtime and/or irregular hours. May be required to complete Rope and Harness Safety Training A valid driver's license is required Preferred: Bachelor’s Degree in a related field such as Risk Management, Insurance, Business, Construction Management or a similar discipline Customer service experience (e.g., assisting customers, handling inquiries/concerns professionally, communicating clearly and empathetically), demonstrating transferable skills that support client interactions in a Claims environment Understanding of property insurance concepts, including coverage fundamentals and general claim handling practices Baseline knowledge of residential and commercial building construction and building components/materials Familiarity with water mitigation principles and inspection processes Working knowledge of Xactimate and XactContents Additional Details: Employees must successfully complete all required training, including applicable proficiency, licensing exam(s), Motor Vehicle Recrd (MVR) checks, and background checks required of various state(s). State Farm recently implemented new pre-employment assessments. Candidates that have previously taken an assessment may be asked to participate in additional testing. Our Benefits Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week! Potential starting salary range: $69,398.62 - $99,000.00 annually. Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family! Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits , locations , and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

jobs.description: Are you ready to transform supply chain operations at a global scale? The Core Selection team in Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) is seeking an innovative software engineer to redefine how Amazon manages inventory selection decisions worldwide. In this role, you'll harness the power of Generative AI to unlock new possibilities in software engineering, collaborating with scientists, economists, business intelligence engineers, and product managers to build solutions that drive financial benefits across teams and organizations. You'll apply your technical depth in distributed systems, work backwards from customer requirements, and leverage advanced technologies to solve complex supply chain challenges. With Amazon's vast and intricate supply chain, even small optimizations create profound impacts on customer experience. This is your opportunity to grow alongside business partners, break through traditional constraints with AI-powered solutions, and deliver scalable systems that shape how millions of customers experience Amazon. Key job responsibilities - Design and build large-scale distributed services for inventory selection decisions, writing high-quality code in Java or Scala while applying object-oriented principles and system design patterns - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, economists, and product managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions, utilizing Generative AI capabilities to accelerate development and expand engineering possibilities - Own the full software development lifecycle from scoping and design through testing, deployment, and maintenance, actively participating in code reviews and providing meaningful technical feedback to team members - Lead operational excellence initiatives by monitoring system performance, identifying root causes of issues, and implementing permanent solutions that improve reliability and customer experience - Evaluate technical tradeoffs in the problem space, balance short-term needs with long-term architectural goals, and make informed decisions on feature development priorities while building trust with partners through domain expertise A day in the life Your day starts with scrum planning where you align with your team on priorities and technical approaches. You'll spend time converting stakeholder requirements into product features, design systems, writing code, and collaborating with economists and data scientists on optimization algorithms. You'll leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate implementation and explore creative solutions. Throughout the day, you participate in design discussions, conduct code reviews, and troubleshoot production systems. You regularly demo progress to stakeholders, gathering feedback to continuously refine and improve your solutions. About the team The Core Selection team in Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) builds the large-scale distributed services that power inventory selection decisions for Amazon's supply chain worldwide. Our mission is clear: even the smallest optimizations in our complex supply chain create profound impacts on customer experience. We're defining the next generation of inventory management solutions at unprecedented scale. Our culture thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. You'll work alongside brilliant engineers, scientists, and technologists who are passionate about solving complex problems. We value curiosity, encourage knowledge-sharing through mentorship, and provide opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies including machine learning, service-oriented architecture, and Generative AI. This is the perfect environment for motivated engineers who want to grow their technical expertise while driving meaningful impact on Amazon's customer experience.

jobs.description: Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Powered by the nation’s largest Gig-speed broadband network and backed by 24/7 customer support, Comcast Business is the nation’s largest technology provider to small businesses and one of the leading service providers to the Enterprise market. Comcast Business has been consistently recognized by industry analysts and associations as a leader and innovator, and one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services. Job Summary Responsible for participating as an individual contributor in project teams, troubleshooting operational issues, providing technical solutions to operational problems, new product implementation, implementing existing products and services and the overall upkeep and maintenance of designated areas of engineering. Interfaces with vendors, engineering and peer operations organizations. Acts in compliance with industry and Company technical requirements, standards, policies and procedures. Provides technical leadership to junior Engineers and project teams. Has in-depth experience, knowledge and skills in own discipline. Integrates knowledge of business and functional priorities. Acts as a key contributor in a complex and crucial environment. May lead teams or projects and shares expertise. Job Description Core Responsibilities Perform network activations for Comcast customers in accordance with established procedures and best practices. Support customer migrations to the Comcast network across various products, including SD-WAN, IPsec, NaaS, MPLS, and SSL VPN solutions. Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP, ensuring optimal network performance and reliability. Apply a solid understanding of routing principles—including route preference based on protocol type, administrative distance, and metric values—to ensure efficient and predictable traffic routing. Analyze routing tables and metrics to validate traffic flow and resolve routing issues. Establish BGP peerings for customers requiring public internet presence and assist in designing appropriate routing policies. Collaborate with carriers to troubleshoot internet circuit issues and ensure timely resolution of connectivity problems. Activate and configure cloud services, including Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) , as part of hybrid or cloud-based network deployments. Deploy and manage virtual appliances in cloud environments, such as FortiGate VMs and Silverpeak virtual instances. Provide technical expertise focused on the data side of the network, ensuring seamless handoff and integration with customer environments. Work with a variety of networking hardware, including Fortinet , Meraki , Cradlepoint , ADVA , and Silverpeak devices. Handle configuration, deployment, and centralized policy management using FortiManager . Configure and support various authentication methods, including RADIUS , LDAP , and SAML , based on customer environments. Enable and manage UTM (Unified Threat Management) features such as firewall policies, antivirus, web filtering, intrusion prevention, and application control. Troubleshoot UTM-related issues, including identifying and resolving incorrect blocks or filtering behavior that impacts legitimate traffic. Collaborate with internal teams and customers to ensure timely and successful activations, migrations, and issue resolutions. Maintain detailed documentation and ticket comments, including activation notes, troubleshooting steps, and post-activation tracking. jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.
We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds. We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models. The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world. A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.
As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.
You will:
Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.
You have:
A track record of solving hard problems.
Proven experience building, shipping, or supporting generative media products — video, image, or world models — or real-time rendering and graphics technology at scale.
Experience productizing research: turning model capabilities into product and product signal back into research priorities, with fluency in the tradeoffs that define this space — quality, latency, inference cost, and compute.
A deep understanding of the product life cycle and a history of collaborating with engineering teams and other stakeholders to deliver complex technical products on time.
Experience shipping to large consumer or creator communities, ideally in gaming, UGC platforms, or creative tools.
A Masters degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, 3D Animation, or Games Production, or a similar technical field.
Passion for driving user-centric product decisions with an inclusive and strategic mindset, comfort in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, and a high degree of independent drive.

Job Description: Manager II, Semiconductor Supply Planning & Procurement About the Position Are you an experienced people leader who can bring together semiconductor commodity strategy, supply planning, procurement execution, and operational excellence to ensure critical components are available when and where they are needed? We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Manager II, Semiconductor Supply Planning & Procurement to build, develop, and lead a team of commodity procurement managers and a buy-sell procurement operations manager supporting HPE Networking sustaining products. The team is responsible for managing the supply of critical semiconductor and memory components, including memory, CPUs, FPGAs, silicon, wireless, and other electronic components. Responsibilities span component forecasting and planning, supplier engagement, procurement execution, inventory management, allocation management, and supply risk mitigation. In this role, you will provide leadership, direction, and operational governance across the component portfolio. You will establish priorities, balance resources, standardize processes, and ensure the team delivers consistent results that support customer commitments and business objectives. You will be accountable for overall component supply health, inventory performance, forecasting effectiveness, procurement execution, and continuity of supply. You will collaborate closely with suppliers, distributors, inventory hubs, ODM/CM partners, engineering, planning, procurement, finance, and operations teams. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep semiconductor supply chain expertise, operational discipline, business acumen, and the ability to communicate complex supply situations to senior leaders. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop a team of commodity procurement managers and procurement operations professionals. Balance resources and priorities across commodities to ensure business objectives are met. Establish team priorities, goals, performance expectations, and accountability measures. Foster a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Support employee development, succession planning, and capability building. Supply Planning & Forecasting Management Own overall supply health across semiconductor and memory commodities. Lead cross-commodity supply reviews and mitigation plans for shortages, allocations, and supply constraints. Lead the team responsible for component forecasting and supply planning, driving forecast accuracy, supply visibility, and alignment with business requirements. Drive initiatives to improve inventory performance, supplier reliability, and continuity of supply. Escalate and resolve critical supply risks impacting production, customer commitments, or business objectives. Procurement, Inventory & Supplier Operations Provide leadership and oversight for procurement execution, purchase order management, supplier commitments, and CRD accuracy. Serve as the escalation point for critical supplier delivery, allocation, and supply continuity issues. Provide directions on supplier engagement strategies, supplier performance management, and executive-level supplier escalations. Ensure inventory is appropriately positioned across distributors, hubs, and manufacturing locations. Drive inventory optimization while maintaining continuity of supply. Establish standardized processes for shortage management, allocation decisions, and supply escalations. Reporting & Business Management Lead executive reporting on component supply health, inventory, supplier performance, shortages, and key business risks. Analyze supply chain performance metrics and drive corrective actions as needed. Develop dashboards and operational reviews that improve visibility, prioritization, and decision-making. Communicate supply risks, mitigation plans, and business impacts to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Standardize procurement, planning, and supply management processes across the team. Drive automation, reporting enhancements, and operational efficiency initiatives. Improve data quality, forecasting accuracy, inventory performance, and supplier execution. Partner with cross-functional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve supply chain performance and visibility. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; advanced university degree preferred. 10+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain, commodity management, supply planning, or supply operations. 3+ years of people management experience leading supply chain or procurement teams. Mastery in English and local language. Strong knowledge of semiconductor and electronic component supply chains, including allocation management, inventory planning, supplier commitments, lead-time management, and lifecycle planning. Experience managing supply across suppliers, distributors, ODM/CM partners, and manufacturing environments. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across multiple organizations. Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency. Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or equivalent platforms. Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting networking, server, storage, or hardware manufacturing environments. Experience managing semiconductor commodities including memory, CPU, FPGA, silicon, and wireless technologies. Experience overseeing inventory hubs, buy-sell procurement operations, and distributor-managed inventory models. Experience working in constrained supply or allocation environments. Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and analytics tools. Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated process improvement experience. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will: Build and lead a high-performing semiconductor supply planning and procurement team. Maintain continuity of supply across critical semiconductor and memory commodities. Improve forecast accuracy, supply visibility, and proactive risk identification. Reduce shortages and costs while improving supplier performance and delivery reliability. Optimize inventory while supporting business and customer requirements. Deliver clear, actionable supply chain insights and recommendations to leadership. Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, improved analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop a strong, engaged team capable of supporting long-term business growth and supply chain resiliency. This position is ideal for a strategic people leader who enjoys developing teams, solving complex semiconductor supply challenges, and driving operational excellence across planning, procurement, and supply management functions. Every year the Online organization runs experiments that decide what ships, what gets rebuilt and what gets abandoned. This role makes those decisions trustworthy. You own the inference methods behind the results, the diagnostics that catch a broken test before anyone reads it, and the design guidance that gets product teams to a well-powered, well-instrumented experiment before a single customer is exposed. The work happens at two altitudes. At the methods altitude, you define and validate the statistical approach used across online experimentation: estimator choice, variance reduction, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, and causal inference where randomization is not possible. At the team altitude, you sit with product managers, engineers, designers and merchants to shape hypotheses, size effects honestly, and interpret results without overclaiming. You are the person who says the test cannot answer that question at this traffic, and the person who says this result is real and we should act on it. This role also builds the AI layer that scales the practice. Experimentation is full of high-volume, judgment-adjacent work: design review, instrumentation checks, readout drafting, anomaly triage. You will design, build and evaluate LLM-based and agentic workflows that absorb that work, so the team's scientists spend their time on the questions that need a human. That means writing the tooling, defining how it connects to our data and platforms, and holding it to an evaluation standard as rigorous as the one you apply to experiments. Success is measured by decision quality and experiment velocity together: more tests, faster, that leaders actually believe. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence, setting the standards that other data scientists and analysts across the Online organization follow. Key Responsibilities: 35% Solution Development - Proficiently design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies; Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution; Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation 30% Project Management & Team Support - Work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals; Provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; Provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; Collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; Support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team 20% Business Collaboration - Leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross-functional teams; Provide general education on advanced analytics to technical and non-technical business partners; Deep understanding of IT needs for the team to be successful in tackling business problems; Actively seek out new business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage 15% Technical Exploration & Development - Seek further knowledge on key developments within data science, technical skill sets, and additional data sources; Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented Direct Manager/Direct Reports: This position reports to manager or above This position has 0 Direct Reports Travel Requirements: Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time. Physical Requirements: Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles. Working Conditions: Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable. Minimum Qualifications: Must be eighteen years of age or older. Must be legally permitted to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Economics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative field 6+ years of quantitative analytics experience, including hands-on ownership of online controlled experiments end to end Deep expertise in experimental design, hypothesis testing, power analysis and causal inference Working knowledge of variance reduction, sequential and always-valid testing, and heterogeneous treatment effect estimation Experience with quasi-experimental methods where randomization is not possible, such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control or geo-based design Proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, and in SQL against a cloud warehouse (preferably Google BigQuery) Experience building production or near-production workflows with LLMs, including prompt design, tool and function calling, retrieval, and multi-step or agentic orchestration Experience defining evaluation for AI systems, including offline benchmarks, human review loops and monitoring for regression Experience with modern experimentation platforms, including server-side testing and feature flag patterns Experience building or independently validating an experimentation statistics engine, not only consuming one Familiarity with e-commerce or retail metrics, including conversion, average order value, attach rate and lifetime value Demonstrated ability to explain statistical trade-offs and uncertainty to non-technical partners and senior leaders Experience mentoring analysts or data scientists and setting technical standards without formal authority Comfort with version control, collaborative code review and shipping internal tooling others depend on Minimum Education: The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job. Preferred Education: No additional education Minimum Years of Work Experience: 5 Preferred Years of Work Experience: No additional years of experience Minimum Leadership Experience: None Preferred Leadership Experience: None Certifications: None Competencies: Attracts Top Talent: Attracting and selecting the best talent to meet current and future business needs Business Insight: Applying knowledge of the business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives Communicates Effectively: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences Cultivates Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful Customer Focus: Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals Directs Work: Provides direction, delegating and removing obstacles to get work done Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances Nimble Learning: Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder Optimizes Work Processes: Knowing the most efficient and effective processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement Self-Development: Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels
